title: Prime Access Trailer/Yareli
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - "Of all the Yuvan theater, your vivacity most captivated me. I would have worn that face with joy. But you concealed deep disrespect beneath shallow waters.
You betrayed our trust, mocked our ways, even dishonored the sacred Kuva.
So others shall wear you now, fatuous nymph. Little ocean flower. Little... Yareli."
